home.storyTitle: A Healing Journey from the Founder's Heart
home.quoteDesc: The spirit of earth and sky distilled into fragrant mugwort leaves and sweet cinnamon bark.
home.storyP1: The Kieu Sang - Herbal House Smudge brand was born from a deep love for rural woodsmoke and a dedication to preserving ancestral herbal traditions. In our modern, hectic world, we recognize that people increasingly long for serene pauses to reconnect with their inner selves.
home.storyP2: By uniting time-honored herbal formulations with Eastern feng shui energy principles, Kieu Sang restores harmony to living spaces: “When a home smells pure and energy flows freely, the soul is nourished with vitality.”
home.storyP3: Every leaf, rind, cinnamon bark, and agarwood is harvested by hand across pristine natural regions of Vietnam, carefully dried to retain the most precious essential oils.
home.imageAlt: Herbal crafting process at Kieu Sang
home.review1Text: After using Kieu Sang smudge products, I felt my living space become noticeably lighter and serene. The lemongrass-cinnamon scent is pure and soothing, never harsh like chemical incenses. Truly a wonderful healing experience.
home.review2Text: The herbal smudge bundle is high quality; its smoke is gentle and subtly sweet rather than pungent. My meditation room feels cleansed of heavy energy, inviting vibrant blessings.
home.review3Text: The herbal purifying mist is my lifesaver during stressful deadline weeks. The natural sweet orange and grapefruit aroma is exceptionally refreshing—truly feels like an at-home spa retreat.

about.subtitle: A journey of preserving and sharing the essence of Vietnamese herbs
about.missionText: Bringing serene space, positive energy, and peace to every home through all-natural herbal creations.

about.traditionalDesc: Inheriting ancestral herbal remedies from centuries of traditional wisdom.

about.storyHeading: FROM PRISTINE MOUNTAINS TO SERENE LIVING SPACES
about.storyP1: Kieu Sang was founded from reflections on bustling, dusty urban life. We observed that reconnecting with peace and healing the mind through the natural scents of native botanicals has become more essential than ever.
about.storyP2: Our journey began with sourcing the finest herbs across the Northwest highlands, Central Vietnam, and the fertile Central Highlands—such as lemongrass, sun-dried mugwort, natural agarwood, and pure cinnamon bark. We harmonize these traditional Vietnamese botanicals using ancient wisdom to craft pure herbal smudge bundles.
about.commitmentsSubtitle: Kieu Sang always prioritizes customer health and environmental purity above all.
about.cleanDesc: Every tea leaf, smudge stick, and incense cone is made from original natural ingredients, hand-harvested and naturally dried, completely free of artificial preservatives.
about.traditionalDesc: Vietnamese medicinal herbs are harmonized according to yin-yang and five-element feng shui, effectively cleansing stale energy while infusing spaces with warm, calming aromas.
about.sustainableDesc: Kieu Sang partners directly with local farming families in clean herb cultivation zones, purchasing at fair prices to foster sustainable local livelihoods.
about.valuesDesc: We believe home is not merely a residence, but a sacred sanctuary for restoring spiritual energy after a demanding day.
